🔍 Find Missing Bacon Troll Tower 🔍

Bacon disappeared years ago without a trace...

But recently, strange clues have started appearing around an abandoned tower. Mysterious footprints, strange traps, and signs that someone may have made it all the way to the top.

Could Bacon still be alive?

🕵️ Investigate the clues.
🧗 Climb through trolls, traps, and tricky obstacles.
🔍 Reach the summit and uncover the truth for yourself.

👥 Bring your friends and see who can solve the mystery first!
⭐ Like 👍 and Favorite ⭐ for more updates!
